devApiBankIntro: Our Bank API allows seamless integration between CashPay and traditional banking systems. To use this API, a bank must first register as a CashPay partner and maintain a float account (compte flotte) with us. This account is used to facilitate instant transfers between the two systems.
devApiBankWithdrawDesc: Initiates a withdrawal from a client's CashPay wallet to their linked bank account. This operation debits the client's CashPay wallet and credits the bank's float account. The bank is then responsible for crediting the client's final bank account.
devApiBankDepositDesc: Notifies CashPay of a deposit made from a client's bank account. After the bank debits their client's account and credits it to their float account at CashPay, it calls this endpoint. CashPay verifies the operation and then credits the client's CashPay wallet.
devWebhooksDesc: Receive real-time notifications about the status of your transactions.
devWebhooksExplain: To be notified of a successful or failed payment, you must provide a `webhook_url` when calling `/api/deposit/initiate`. Our system will send a POST request to this URL with the final status of the transaction.
devWebhooksResponse: Your server must respond with an HTTP status code of `200` to acknowledge receipt of the webhook.
